outcome: pain scores (measured by 100-point visual analog scale)
cohort: The cohort consisted of women aged 45 years or older presenting with abnormal uterine bleeding, postmenopausal bleeding, or thickened endometrial stripe.
finding: Gynecologic tract sampling using a tampon resulted in significantly lower pain scores compared to both Tao brush and endometrial biopsy methods.
cross-section timing: Pain scores were measured immediately after each sampling procedure during the study period (December 2015 to August 2017).
